text:
mara: FYI I opened a tiny docs PR to add a Python snippet for prefix prefetch + a short UX note about toggling prefetch rules in Console. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4628
josh: Nice. Can you paste the Python snippet inline here so I can do a quick sanity check?
mara: Sure, excerpt in PR. Main pattern: use PrefetchClient, call prefetch(...).catch style in async wrapper. Example uses batch=4, seq=512.
rina: UX note: please avoid saying "enable prefetch" generically. We have a toggle per-route; recommend wording "configure per-route prefetch rules" and link to console anchor.
mara: Updated wording in the PR to "configure per-route prefetch rules (Console -> Optimize -> Prefetch)" and added anchor /console/optimize/prefetch#per-route.
anya: Quick nit: in the Python snippet you import OldPrefetcher in the example. We renamed that to PrefetchClient in 2025-11.
mara: Good catch, swapping. Also added a short migration note: "OldPrefetcher -> PrefetchClient: method signatures unchanged except `setup` -> `init`."
josh: Snippet correctness: in the async pattern make sure we show session/context usage: `with PrefetchClient(...) as client:` so users don't leak connections.
mara: Swapped to context manager pattern and pushed.
ci-bot: checks: md-lint passed, snippets/py-format failed (black)
mara: Running black locally and pushing fix.
(1 minute)
mara: Fixed formatting and removed a debug print.
ci-bot: snippets/py-format passed, link-checker shows 1 internal anchor mismatch
josh: Which anchor?
mara: The qprofile link used id qprof-small, but the canonical is qprof-small-int8. Updating.
docs-bot: checklist: [x] PR opened, [ ] reviewer assigned, [x] snippets linted, [x] links validated, [ ] UX wording reviewed
rina: UX wording now reads well. One more micro: say "cache hit" rather than "cache hit rate" in the example sentence to avoid implying steady-state numbers.
mara: Changed sentence to "Observed cache hit in this test: ~85%" and added test conditions bullet: - hardware: A100 - batch: 4 - seq: 512 - quant profile: qprof-small-int8
anya: Can you add a note about fallback behavior: if prefix missing we fall back to model variant v1-small; users sometimes think prefetch will create prefixes.
mara: Added fallback note and a crosslink to /docs/optimize/fallbacks.
josh: LGTM from a code POV. Minor suggestion: show a one-liner for installing the SDK pin version `pip install redwood-sdk==0.9.3` so users on older versions see migration step.
mara: Added that to the top of the snippet.
docs-bot: checklist: [x] PR opened, [x] reviewer assigned, [x] snippets linted, [x] links validated, [x] UX wording reviewed
mara: Merged and deployed to staging. Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optimize/prefetch-python-smokecheck
josh: Quick smoke: code block renders, link anchors resolve.
rina: Verified fallback crosslink. lgtm.
anya: Thanks! This should cut down support tickets. :pray:
